note: Declared HS 680223 matches the actual customs HS codes seen (68022390 / 68022310 — polished granite slabs and monuments), so no HS correction is needed. Export side is factually confirmed by dated Indian customs/bill-of-lading records with destinations Azerbaijan (Baku), Russia (Novorossiysk) and Kyrgyzstan (Bishkek); the granite flows to Baku and Novorossiysk are consistent and repeat across 2025-11 to 2026-02. Note the company also ships non-stone goods (fresh cut roses to Bishkek), i.e. it behaves as a multi-commodity trader, not a pure granite producer — role likely trader/manufacturer_trader, not verified.
